data.about:
Explore the new launch at JVC, Binghatti Azure, where architectural mastery and innovative design redefine modern living. location_tile.description:
Explore the vibrant Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) with Binghatti Azure, prominently featured on the Binghatti Azure location map. This prime location is surrounded by an assortment of green parks within a compact eight kilometer community, ensuring a park is always nearby, regardless of your apartment’s location.
